hint.zh: 两个 →，两个框，一个套一个。
hint.en: Two →s, two boxes, one inside the other.

hint.zh: 里面的框看得见「下雨 → 地湿」和「¬地湿」，也就是「地湿 → ⊥」。
hint.en: The inner box sees “it rains → the ground is wet” and “¬the ground is wet”, that is “wet → ⊥”.

t.zh: 「下雨，地就湿」，那么「地不湿，就没下雨」。这叫<wiki-ref to="contrapositive"></wiki-ref>。和<level-ref to="onerow"></level-ref>里那个错误的推理不同，它永远成立：「(下雨 → 地湿) → (¬地湿 → ¬下雨)」。
t.en: “If it rains, the ground is wet”, so “if the ground is not wet, it did not rain”. This is the <wiki-ref to="contrapositive"></wiki-ref>, and unlike the bad reasoning of <level-ref to="onerow"></level-ref> it always holds: “(it rains → the ground is wet) → (¬the ground is wet → ¬it rains)”.
